visibleTestCases.title: Start Acceptor Pool & Connect 2 Clients
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, Mgr, Port} = tcp_acceptor_pool:start_pool(0, 3), {ok, S1} = gen_tcp:connect("127.0.0.1", Port, [binary, {packet, raw}, {active, false}], 2000), {ok, S2} = gen_tcp:connect("127.0.0.1", Port, [binary, {packet, raw}, {active, false}], 2000), timer:sleep(50), Cnt = tcp_acceptor_pool:get_active_workers(Mgr), ok = gen_tcp:send(S1, <<"PING\r\n">>), {ok, Rep} = gen_tcp:recv(S1, 0, 2000), gen_tcp:close(S1), gen_tcp:close(S2), tcp_acceptor_pool:stop_pool(Mgr), {Cnt, Rep} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies 2 concurrent connections accepted and request/reply executed.

visibleTestCases.title: Direct Socket Handoff to Worker
visibleTestCases.erlangCall:
begin {ok, L} = gen_tcp:listen(0, [binary, {active, false}]), {ok, Port} = inet:port(L), Receiver = spawn(fun() -> receive {socket_assigned, S} -> inet:setopts(S, [{active, once}]), receive {tcp, S, <<"HI
">>} -> ok = gen_tcp:send(S, <<"ACK
">>) end end end), {ok, Client} = gen_tcp:connect("127.0.0.1", Port, [binary, {active, false}], 2000), {ok, ServerSock} = gen_tcp:accept(L, 2000), ok = tcp_acceptor_pool:handoff_socket(ServerSock, Receiver), ok = gen_tcp:send(Client, <<"HI
">>), {ok, Rep} = gen_tcp:recv(Client, 0, 2000), gen_tcp:close(Client), gen_tcp:close(L), Rep end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Directly validates handoff_socket/2 transfers controlling process and signals receiver.
